ideas.title: FBI Transparency in State Investigations
ideas.description: Investigate the extent to which the FBI withholds evidence from state authorities in investigations
questions: What are the implications of the FBI's refusal to share evidence for state-federal relations?
How common is this practice in other investigations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal a larger pattern of federal agencies withholding information from state authorities, which could have significant implications for accountability and cooperation. By investigating this trend, we may uncover a systemic issue that requires reform.
